summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 41 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: What to Know About California’s Executive Order on A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Okta’s CEO is betting big on AI agent identity
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 38 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom, a Democrat, issued an order requiring safety and privacy guardrails for artificial intelligence companies contracting with the state.
